prompts.title: Petaled Sky

The scene combines the fluid power of nature with the technological pulse of modern music equipment.

prompts.title: Fisherman’s Drum Machine

prompts.title: Drummer’s Bridge

The peaceful landscape is set against the glowing lights of drum machines, creating a harmonious contrast between the natural world and the electronic beats.

prompts.title: Samurai’s Beat

Behind him, traditional ukiyo-e-style landscapes unfold, with stylized clouds and mountains surrounding the samurai, whose drum machine adds a modern beat to the traditional world.

prompts.title: Geisha’s Rhythm

The background features delicate flowers, with the soft, rhythmic sounds of the drum machine blending with the elegance of the traditional setting.

prompts.title: Drum Machine’s Moon

A lone figure stands on the shore, gazing at the sky, while drum pads hover above them like celestial bodies. The swirling clouds and tranquil waves of the ukiyo-e scene are paired with the pulsating lights of the drum machines, creating a surreal atmosphere.

prompts.title: Drum Machine in the Garden
prompts.prompt: A serene ukiyo-e garden scene, with blooming flowers and fluttering birds, is reimagined with a drum machine at the center of the composition. The stillness of the garden contrasts beautifully with the lively energy of the drum machine.

prompts.title: Drumming Fisherman

prompts.title: Mountain Drum Machine
prompts.prompt: A tranquil mountain landscape, inspired by ukiyo-e, is now home to towering drum machines replacing traditional natural elements like trees or rocks. prompts.title: Drum Machine and the Koi Pond

prompts.title: Avian Circuit

prompts.title: Solar-powered Mech with Dreadlock Vines
prompts.prompt: A solar-powered mech with dreadlock vines and a massive speaker cannon rides the cosmic winds. The pilot, a relaxed rasta with glowing red, yellow, and green tattoos, adjusts the bassline as “JAde Wii” pulses across the mech’s screens.

prompts.title: Mecha Reggae Band with Turntable Heads
prompts.prompt: A mecha reggae band with turntable heads performs on a floating dub stage. A dreadlocked DJ girl stands at the front, mixing tracks on a console that glows with “JAde Wii” in vibrant rasta colors, sending musical waves across the stars.

prompts.title: Dub-powered Mech with Glowing Red Green
prompts.prompt: A dub-powered mech with glowing red, green, and yellow accents hums through a space jungle. The pilot, a rasta boy with a speaker helmet, grooves to the beat as his mech’s massive bass cannon vibrates “JAde Wii” across the galaxy.

prompts.title: Reggae-inspired Mecha Surfer Glides
prompts.prompt: A reggae-inspired mecha surfer glides through a cosmic sea of colors. With dreadlocks flowing in the space breeze, the pilot adjusts her speakers on the mech's shoulder, and the colors of the Jamaican flag flicker across the sky with "JAde Wii" in the center.

prompts.title: Reggae-themed Spacecraft with Bamboo and Dreadlock
prompts.prompt: A reggae-themed spacecraft with bamboo and dreadlock textures floats past a distant nebula. The pilot, a chill rasta girl with a glowing sun hat, watches as “JAde Wii” pulses in harmony with the dub beats that fill the air.

prompts.title: Giant Mecha Guitar Strung with Laser
prompts.prompt: A giant mecha guitar, strung with laser wires, floats in a cosmic soundscape. The pilot, a rasta warrior with an oversized dreadlock mohawk, strums its strings as the “JAde Wii” logo floats in colorful waves of red, green, and yellow.

prompts.title: Massive Mecha with Vines Crawling
prompts.prompt: A massive mecha with vines crawling over its steel frame hovers over a nebula of glowing plant spores. The pilot, a girl in a pod suit, gazes out from a cockpit where “JAde Wii” is etched into a bio-laser.

prompts.title: Moon-sized Mecha Shaped Like a Lotus
prompts.prompt: A moon-sized mecha shaped like a lotus flower spins in orbit. A girl with glowing green eyes in a moss-covered spacesuit pilots it, her hand resting on a leafy control panel that flickers “JAde Wii.”

prompts.title: Walking Mecha Forest Made of Giant
prompts.prompt: A walking mecha forest made of giant trees and rusted gears stomps through a desolate space station. A girl in an exoskeleton suit with vine-covered arms stands on top, holding a glowing “JAde Wii” seed crystal.

prompts.title: Enormous Cactus-shaped Mech Unfurls its Giant
prompts.prompt: An enormous cactus-shaped mech unfurls its giant petals, releasing sparkling plant robots. A boy with solar-powered goggles rides inside, holding a console with “JAde Wii” glowing in neon green across the screen.

prompts.title: Bio-mecha with Algae-infused Armor Floats
prompts.prompt: A bio-mecha with algae-infused armor floats in a sea of stars. Inside, a young girl with vine-like hair navigates, the cockpit filled with flowering plants, as “JAde Wii” pulses from the cockpit's transparent canopy.

prompts.title: Forest of Massive Bio-mechas their Limbs
prompts.prompt: A forest of massive bio-mechas, their limbs covered in moss and flowers, drift through a space garden. A girl in a verdant suit carries a glowing “JAde Wii” orb as she strolls beneath their towering forms.

prompts.title: Floating Vine-wrapped Mecha Temple Drifts
prompts.prompt: A floating, vine-wrapped mecha temple drifts through a cosmic jungle. A quiet pilot in a plant-suit communicates with her mecha, whose eyes flicker “JAde Wii” in bright, bioluminescent colors.

prompts.title: Forest of Mecha-trees Grows
prompts.prompt: A forest of mecha-trees grows in the vacuum of space, their metal branches interwoven with glowing flora. A space knight in a living armor suit holds a leaf-bladed sword, and behind her, “JAde Wii” floats in digital glyphs.

prompts.title: Mecha with Solar-panel Wings Bursts
prompts.prompt: A mecha with solar-panel wings bursts through a cloud of space pollen, leaving a trail of shimmering, bioluminescent flowers behind. Inside, a girl with plant tattoos steers, her cockpit filled with floating “JAde Wii” spores.

prompts.title: Colossal Mecha Shaped Like a Space
prompts.prompt: A colossal mecha shaped like a space cactus stands guard over a lush alien planet. The pilot, a young girl with glowing plant tendrils extending from her shoulders, taps the control console where “JAde Wii” is written in glowing green vines.

prompts.title: Lonely Janitor Robot with Cassette Teeth
prompts.prompt: A lonely janitor robot with cassette teeth sweeps stardust off a broken satellite garden. His only friend, a girl encoded in hologram static, smiles from a pocket-sized CRT. “JAde Wii” blinks softly from his broom handle.

prompts.title: Jellyfish-shaped AI Shrine Orbits Jupiter
prompts.prompt: A jellyfish-shaped AI shrine orbits Jupiter. Inside, a shrine maiden with printer-paper sleeves prays to an altar made of joystick relics. Her shadow is a mech with “JAde Wii” carved into its ribcage.

prompts.title: Boy with a Keyboard Chest
prompts.prompt: A boy with a keyboard chest and walkman ears floats through a nebula made of dial-up tones. He reaches for his pet modem-spider, who’s projecting “JAde Wii” from its glowing abdomen.

prompts.title: Mech Girl Made of Fax Machines
prompts.prompt: A mech girl made of fax machines and floppy disks lounges atop a drifting motherboard temple. Her finger presses a floating button labeled “RESET: JAde Wii” as robot pigeons orbit her head.

prompts.title: Twin-tailed Hacker Girl with a Projector
prompts.prompt: A twin-tailed hacker girl with a projector visor jacks into a starship’s nervous system. Her glowing veins spell out cheat codes, and on her shoulder, a mini mech-mouse chirps “JAde Wii” in Morse code.

prompts.title: Old Vacuum-tube Golem Plays Vinyl Records
prompts.prompt: An old vacuum-tube golem plays vinyl records to terraform a music planet. A satellite-headed toddler in pajamas watches, her pillow screen showing a looping “JAde Wii” intro cutscene.

prompts.title: Rusted Mech Suit is Used
prompts.prompt: A rusted mech suit is used as a greenhouse for alien tulips. Inside, a gentle AI gardener with motherboard skin gently waters plants. Her watering can is a joystick labeled “JAde Wii” in cursive chrome.

prompts.title: Battlesuit-clad Courier Girl with Heat-sink Hair
prompts.prompt: A battlesuit-clad courier girl with heat-sink hair skates across asteroid mailboxes. She tosses VHS messages to robot families while her rocket cat trails a glitching flag that reads “JAde Wii.”

prompts.title: Digital Fox Spirit Lives Inside
prompts.prompt: A digital fox spirit lives inside a space capsule arcade machine. A small boy with a plasma-lantern backpack plugs in and meets her face-to-face. The screen flashes “JAde Wii: Insert Soul to Continue.”

prompts.title: Pilot with Magnet Hands Climbs
prompts.prompt: A pilot with magnet hands climbs a skyscraper-sized audio jack in a void of floating cassette cubes. Behind him, his EVA mech—made from old MIDI gear—pulses with sound waves spelling “JAde Wii.”

prompts.title: Starlit Scrapyard Orbits Saturn Littered
prompts.prompt: A starlit scrapyard orbits Saturn, littered with singing screw-bots and blinking diodes. A robot girl in a bubble helmet tunes her laser harp while “JAde Wii” scrolls across a blinking satellite above her.

prompts.title: Chrome Rabbit Mech Drifts
prompts.prompt: A chrome rabbit mech drifts through a meteor belt shaped like candy. Riding on its back, a visor-eyed girl with antenna pigtails waves at a passing UFO stamped “JAde Wii” in glowing blue katakana.

prompts.title: Inside a Floating Vending Machine Planet
prompts.prompt: Soda-can drones beep in harmony. A jetpack kid with a CRT face rewires the stars as a giant game controller moon pulses “JAde Wii.”

prompts.title: Neon Mecha with Flower Decals Poses
prompts.prompt: A neon mecha with flower decals poses dramatically on a zero-gravity battlefield of broken arcade machines. The pilot, a calm girl with USB braids, raises a flag marked “JAde Wii limited edition.”

prompts.title: Space Train Made of Speaker Cabinets
prompts.prompt: A space train made of speaker cabinets rattles past asteroid gardens where robot deer graze. A girl in a hover-skirt and blinking chest screen watches quietly, “JAde Wii” reflected in her glass visor.

prompts.title: Satellite Palace Blooms with Antennae
prompts.prompt: A satellite palace blooms with antennae and gears. At its core, a jelly-limbed robot prince and a glitch fairy girl play chess with planets. A tiny floating PDA screen spells “JAde Wii.”

prompts.title: Cosmic Highway of Rainbow Circuits Stretches
prompts.prompt: A cosmic highway of rainbow circuits stretches into the void. A hoverboard gang of chibi drones chase a bubble-headed pilot girl whose scarf displays “JAde Wii” in scrolling ASCII.

prompts.title: On the Moon's Far Side
prompts.prompt: Forgotten game console spins and hums. A cyborg monk meditates while tiny robot monks orbit, chanting in tones that visually render “JAde Wii” into the stars.

prompts.title: Solar Flare Erupts into 8-bit Music
prompts.prompt: A solar flare erupts into 8-bit music notes as a battle angel with magnetic wings hovers above. Her laser sword flickers out “JAde Wii” while a robotic cat fuses comets into floppy disks below.

prompts.title: Tower of Orbiting Cassette Mechs Guards
prompts.prompt: A tower of orbiting cassette mechs guards a binary black hole. A mechanic in a bubble-suit drifts by on a paper airplane drone, with “JAde Wii” blinking on her shoulder-mounted AI assistant.

prompts.title: Candy-colored Factory Puffs Out Heart-shaped Smoke
prompts.prompt: A candy-colored factory puffs out heart-shaped smoke while a boy with CRT eyes rides a jellyfish-shaped hoverboard. Behind him, “JAde Wii” is etched into a floating moon with bunny ears.

prompts.title: Rocket-powered Tricycle Launches from a Rainbow
prompts.prompt: A rocket-powered tricycle launches from a rainbow cliff. The pilot, a frog in a school uniform, salutes a girl with holographic hair who holds a joystick like a magic wand. The Namco logo flickers in the clouds.

prompts.title: Crystalline Desert Hums with Neon Beetles
prompts.prompt: A crystalline desert hums with neon beetles. A detective kitten in a trench coat scans the horizon while a laughing toaster droid prints out the words “JAde Wii limited edition.”

prompts.title: Glitchy Sky Pours Pixel Rain
prompts.prompt: A glitchy sky pours pixel rain over a town of paper houses. A bubblegum-haired robot girl sits under an umbrella shaped like an old MIDI keyboard. Her backpack whispers “JAde Wii” in glowing katakana.

prompts.title: Kaiju-sized Cassette Tape Stomps Across
prompts.prompt: A kaiju-sized cassette tape stomps across a synthwave sea as a girl in star-shaped headphones surfs on a floppy disk. Her robotic dolphin sidekick howls “JAde Wii!” into a speech bubble.

prompts.title: Quiet Train Made of Pencils Rolls
prompts.prompt: A quiet train made of pencils rolls through a dreamscape garden. A shy ghost in roller skates holds a lollipop radar as a girl with screen-glitch freckles waves from the caboose marked “JAde Wii.”

prompts.title: Cat-eared Pilot with a Wrench Tail
prompts.prompt: A cat-eared pilot with a wrench tail hangs upside-down from a floating arcade cabinet. Behind her, pastel cities shaped like sound waves twist into the words “JAde Wii” above a VHS sun.

prompts.title: Melon-colored Jungle Typewriter Birds Chirp
prompts.prompt: In a melon-colored jungle, typewriter birds chirp code while a shy android boy with a monitor face paints clouds with a joystick brush. His paint says “JAde Wii” in flickering green text.

prompts.title: Jelly-armor Samurai Stands in a Tea
prompts.prompt: A jelly-armor samurai stands in a tea shop built on a whale’s back. As the moon blinks like a CRT test screen, an antenna-haired girl sips glowing soda from a can labeled “JAde Wii.”

prompts.title: Motherboard Meadow Sprouts Daisies with Emoticon
prompts.prompt: A motherboard meadow sprouts daisies with emoticon faces. A pixelated sheep floats by as a glitch princess holds a sword shaped like an old stylus. Her cape spells out “JAde Wii” in spinning binary.
